decisions: Story BASELINE-002 is a synthetic test case for token usage measurement across 10 pipeline phases.

decisions: Phase 2 elaborates phase 1 intake into full functional specification; no new ACs introduced; all 7 original ACs addressed.
Data model: single column addition (profile_image_url, profile_image_updated_at) to users table; no new table; coordinator with solution architect required before DB migration is written.
API design: 3 RESTful endpoints (POST/DELETE/GET) on /users/{userId}/profile-image; all require authenticated session; cross-user access blocked at authorization layer.
Transaction pattern: SELECT FOR UPDATE → S3 upload → DB UPDATE → COMMIT → async old-object delete; compensating rollback on S3 success + DB failure.
Security posture: private S3 ACL + presigned URLs; MIME magic-byte validation; CSRF token on web; no CJIS patterns involved (G-10 not triggered).
Three open questions (OPEN-2 image resizing, OPEN-3 S3/CDN strategy, OPEN-4 soft vs hard delete) carried forward as MEDIUM OPEN findings; OPEN-3 is BLOCKING for software-engineer phase if unresolved.
Performance: 30s server timeout, single concurrent upload per user via row lock, 5MB hard limit at validation, S3 presigned URL TTL 3600s configurable.
Platform notes: iOS HEIC→JPEG conversion before upload; Android Bitmap decode for dimension check; Web client-side pre-validation + server authoritative re-validation.

decisions: OPEN-3 resolved: S3 us-east-1, same-region, private ACL, presigned URLs (3600s TTL), no CDN at launch.
OPEN-2 resolved: store originals; no server-side resize (minimal-change default, ResizeService insertable in future).
OPEN-4 resolved: permanent delete; DB NULL authoritative; orphan cleanup async.
API design: multipart POST (200 return), idempotent DELETE (204), GET (200/404). Auth: JWT + CSRF (web).
Backend: ProfileImageController, Service, S3Adapter, validators, OrphanCleanupShell. Zero impact on existing codegraph.
Mobile: iOS UIImagePickerController + HEIC→JPEG; Android ACTION_GET_CONTENT + bitmap check.
Web: fetch multipart, drag-drop, progress events. Client-side retry with exponential backoff.
DB: additive-only migration (2 nullable columns, IF NOT EXISTS guard).

decisions: Magic byte validation (not MIME type) for file format security; prevents extension spoofing.
5 MB hard limit enforced via DimensionValidator before S3 upload; fail-fast approach.
S3Adapter presigned URLs generated on-demand (3600s TTL), never stored in DB per ADR-005.
Same-key overwrite strategy (users/{userId}/profile.{ext}) for replace; extension changes create orphans logged for async cleanup.
Idempotent DELETE: null DB values and attempt S3 delete; if S3 fails, orphan logged, DB authoritative.
SELECT FOR UPDATE row lock in ProfileImageService enforces one concurrent upload per user (AC-4 concurrency).
48 unit tests across 5 test classes; estimated >=85% coverage on changed lines via comprehensive path + boundary testing.
AC-6 and AC-7 descoped to phase 6+ (QA/E2E); backend provides REST endpoints for mobile/web UI consumption.
Database migration additive-only; IF NOT EXISTS guards for idempotent reruns; no rollback support (per ADR-005).
